modern: Try how the life of the good man suits you, the life of one who is satisfied with his share of the whole, and satisfied with his own just acts and kindly disposition.
original: Try how the life of the good man suits thee, the life of him who is satisfied with his portion out of the whole, and satisfied with his own just acts and benevolent disposition.
